prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
Determining a single "best" dentist depends on your specific needs (such as single-tooth replacement vs. full-mouth reconstruction or oral surgery), but several highly credentialed implant specialists and practices stand out in the Dallas area:
Doctors: Dr. McFadden and Dr. Tan
Highlights: Focuses heavily on prosthodontics and implantology. Dr. McFadden is double board-certified in both prosthodontics and implantology—a rare distinction. Patients highlight personalized care and attention to structural perfection. Learn more via The Dental Implant Center on Yelp.
Doctor: Dr. Tony Lin
Highlights: Specializes in immediate-load/same-day dental implants, single crowns, fixed bridges, and "All-on-4" arch restorations. www.dentistindallastexas.com
Doctor: Dr. Cory Nguyen, DDS, DABOI, DABDSM
Highlights: Graduate of Texas A&M Baylor College of Dentistry with diplomate status with the American Board of Oral Implantology/Implant Dentistry (ABOI) and fellowship with the American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID). Offers single implants and "All-On-X" full-mouth restorations. Beyond Dental & Implant Center
Doctor: Dr. William H. Miller, D.M.D.
Highlights: Master in the Academy of General Dentistry and Fellow in the International Congress of Oral Implantologists. Provides single crowns, bridges, and customized root-to-crown replacements. dallastexasdentistoffice.com
Highlights: Over 20 years of experience in Dallas utilizing 3D cone beam imaging and computer-guided implant placement for single-tooth and bridge supports. Keith W. Brewster DDS
Doctors: Dr. Mounir Iskandar and Dr. Ola Al Hatem
Highlights: Combines over 50 years of experience in oral implantology with an on-site dental lab specializing in All-on-4 dentures and full-mouth reconstructions. Radiance Dentistry Dental Implant Center
If you share what kind of procedure you need (like a single tooth, full-mouth All-on-4, or bone grafting) or your preferred neighborhood in Dallas, I can help narrow down the best choice for you.
